parts.zh: 新墨西哥州一名9岁女孩为需要在德克萨斯州休斯顿接受心脏手术的弟弟筹集了500多美元
M: David告诉我你有个特别的生日要到了
M: 那是什么意思？我从来没听说过黄金生日
W: 其实我自己也是刚知道这个概念
M: 有意思。可惜我错过了我的
W: 确实是的。我丈夫正在计划下周给我们俩安排一个惊喜假期
W: 有什么可以分享的吗？我特别想知道他计划的是什么样的旅行

items.stem: Who did Addison raise the money for?

choices.text: Her grandfather.
choices.zh: 她的祖父。

choices.text: Her grandmother.
choices.zh: 她的祖母。

choices.text: Her friend Erika.
choices.zh: 她的朋友 Erika。

choices.text: Her little brother.
choices.zh: 她的弟弟。

items.stem: How did Addison raise the money?

choices.text: By taking pictures for passers-by.
choices.zh: 为路人拍照。

choices.text: By selling lemonade and pictures.
choices.zh: 售卖柠檬水和照片。

choices.text: By working part time at a hospital.
choices.zh: 在医院做兼职。

choices.text: By asking for help on social media.
choices.zh: 在社交媒体上寻求帮助。

items.stem: What was France's purpose of constructing the Ward Way?

choices.text: Testing the efficiency of the new solar panel.
choices.zh: 测试新型太阳能电池板的效率。

choices.text: Providing clean energy to five million people.
choices.zh: 为五百万人提供清洁能源。

choices.text: Generating electric power for passing vehicles.
choices.zh: 为过往车辆发电。

choices.text: Finding cheaper ways of highway construction.
choices.zh: 寻找更便宜的公路建设方式。

items.stem: What is special about the solar panels used in the Ward Way?

choices.text: They are made from cheap materials.
choices.zh: 它们由廉价材料制成。

choices.text: They are only about half an inch thick.
choices.zh: 它们只有大约半英寸厚。

choices.text: They can be laid right on top of existing highways.
choices.zh: 它们可以直接铺设在现有公路上面。

choices.text: They can stand the wear and tear of natural elements.
choices.zh: 它们能够承受自然因素的磨损。

items.stem: What has made it difficult to survey lions in remote parts of Sudan and Ethiopia?

choices.text: The lack of clues about the species.
choices.zh: 缺乏关于该物种的线索。

choices.text: Inadequate funding for research.
choices.zh: 研究资金不足。

choices.text: Endless fighting in the region.
choices.zh: 该地区无休止的战斗。

choices.text: The hazards from the desert.
choices.zh: 来自沙漠的危险。

items.stem: What was the main purpose of the research?

choices.text: To observe the wildlife in the two national parks.
choices.zh: 观察两个国家公园内的野生动物。

choices.text: To study the habitat of lions in Sudan and Ethiopia.
choices.zh: 研究苏丹和埃塞俄比亚狮子的栖息地。

choices.text: To identify the reasons for the lions' disappearance.
choices.zh: 查明狮子消失的原因。

choices.text: To find evidence of the existence of the "lost lions".
choices.zh: 寻找"失踪的狮子"存在的证据。

items.stem: What did the researchers find in the national park?

choices.text: Lions' tracks.
choices.zh: 狮子的足迹。

choices.text: Lions walking.
choices.zh: 正在行走的狮子。

choices.text: Some camping facilities.
choices.zh: 一些露营设施。

choices.text: Traps set by local hunters.
choices.zh: 当地猎人设置的陷阱。

items.stem: What is the woman looking forward to?

choices.text: A special gift from the man.
choices.zh: 来自这位男士的特别礼物。

choices.text: Her wedding anniversary.
choices.zh: 她的结婚纪念日。

choices.text: A call from her dad.
choices.zh: 她父亲打来的电话。

choices.text: Her 'lucky birthday'.
choices.zh: 她的"幸运生日"。

items.stem: What did the woman's parents do on her sister's lucky birthday?

choices.text: Threw her a surprise party.
choices.zh: 为她举办了一个惊喜派对。

choices.text: Took her on a trip overseas.
choices.zh: 带她去海外旅行。

choices.text: Bought her a gold necklace.
choices.zh: 给她买了一条金项链。

choices.text: Gave her a big model plane.
choices.zh: 送给她一个大型飞机模型。

items.stem: What is the woman eager to find out about?

choices.text: What her husband and the man are up to.
choices.zh: 她丈夫和这位男士在策划什么。

choices.text: What has been troubling her husband.
choices.zh: 一直困扰她丈夫的是什么。

choices.text: The trip her husband has planned.
choices.zh: 她丈夫计划的旅行。

choices.text: The gift her husband has bought.
choices.zh: 她丈夫买的礼物。

items.stem: What does the man say at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: He wants to find out about the couple's holiday plan.
choices.zh: 他想了解这对夫妇的度假计划。

choices.text: He is eager to learn how the couple's holiday turns out.
choices.zh: 他渴望知道这对夫妇的度假结果如何。

choices.text: He will tell the woman the secret if her husband agrees.
choices.zh: 如果她丈夫同意,他会告诉这位女士这个秘密。

choices.text: He will be glad to be a guide for the couple's holiday trip.
choices.zh: 他很乐意为这对夫妇的度假旅行当导游。

items.stem: What does the man say about good negotiators?

choices.text: They take the rival's attitude into account.
choices.zh: 他们会考虑对手的态度。

choices.text: They know when to adopt a tough attitude.
choices.zh: 他们知道何时采取强硬态度。

choices.text: They see the importance of making compromises.
choices.zh: 他们认识到做出妥协的重要性。

choices.text: They are sensitive to the dynamics of a negotiation.
choices.zh: 他们对谈判的动态变化很敏感。

items.stem: What does the man say, maybe the most important thing to a successful negotiator?

choices.text: They know when to stop.
choices.zh: 他们知道何时停止。

choices.text: They know how to adapt.
choices.zh: 他们知道如何适应。

choices.text: They know when to make compromises.
choices.zh: 他们知道何时做出妥协。

choices.text: They know how to control their emotion.
choices.zh: 他们知道如何控制自己的情绪。

items.stem: How is a good negotiator different from a poor one?

choices.text: They are patient.
choices.zh: 他们有耐心。

choices.text: They learn quickly.
choices.zh: 他们学得快。

choices.text: They are good at expression.
choices.zh: 他们善于表达。

choices.text: They uphold their principles.
choices.zh: 他们坚持自己的原则。

items.stem: What's the first stage of a negation according to the man?

choices.text: Clarify items of negotiation.
choices.zh: 明确谈判事项。

choices.text: Make clear one's intentions.
choices.zh: 阐明自己的意图。

choices.text: Get to know the other side.
choices.zh: 了解对方。

choices.text: Formulate one's strategy.
choices.zh: 制定自己的策略。

items.stem: What do some people want to know about space exploration?

choices.text: How space research benefits people on Earth.
choices.zh: 太空研究如何使地球上的人们受益。

choices.text: When the International Space Station was built.
choices.zh: 国际空间站是何时建造的。

choices.text: How many space shuttle missions there will be.
choices.zh: 将会有多少次航天飞机任务。

choices.text: When America's earliest space program started.
choices.zh: 美国最早的太空计划是何时开始的。

items.stem: What did scientists do for the space shuttle missions?

choices.text: They tried to make best use of the latest technology.
choices.zh: 他们试图充分利用最新技术。

choices.text: They tried to meet astronauts' specific requirements.
choices.zh: 他们试图满足宇航员的具体要求。

choices.text: They developed objects for astronauts to use in outer space.
choices.zh: 他们开发了供宇航员在外太空使用的物品。

choices.text: They accurately calculated the speed of the orbiting shuttles.
choices.zh: 他们精确计算了轨道航天飞机的速度。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the quartz crystal clocks and watches?

choices.text: They are expensive to make.
choices.zh: 它们制造成本高昂。

choices.text: They are extremely accurate.
choices.zh: 它们极其精确。

choices.text: They were first made in space.
choices.zh: 它们最初是在太空中制造的。

choices.text: They were invented in the 1970s.
choices.zh: 它们是在20世纪70年代发明的。

items.stem: Why does the speaker say she would like to go back and live in the 18th century America?

choices.text: Everything was natural and genuine then.
choices.zh: 那时一切都是自然和真实的。

choices.text: People had plenty of land to cultivate then.
choices.zh: 那时人们有大量土地可以耕种。

choices.text: It marked the beginning of something new.
choices.zh: 它标志着新事物的开端。

choices.text: It was when her ancestors came to America.
choices.zh: 那是她的祖先来到美国的时候。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the Puritans?

choices.text: They were known to be creative.
choices.zh: 他们以富有创造力而闻名。

choices.text: They enjoyed living a life of ease.
choices.zh: 他们享受安逸的生活。

choices.text: They had all kinds of entertainment.
choices.zh: 他们有各种各样的娱乐活动。

choices.text: They believed in working for goals.
choices.zh: 他们相信为目标而努力。

items.stem: What would the speaker like doing if she could go back to the past?

choices.text: Chatting with her ancestors.
choices.zh: 与她的祖先聊天。

choices.text: Doing needlework by the fire.
choices.zh: 在炉火旁做针线活。

choices.text: Furnishing her country house.
choices.zh: 布置她的乡村住宅。

choices.text: Polishing all the silver work.
choices.zh: 擦亮所有的银器。

items.stem: What does the speaker advise you to do first if you are lost in the woods?

choices.text: Sit down and try to calm yourself.
choices.zh: 坐下来试着让自己冷静下来。

choices.text: Call your family or friends for help.
choices.zh: 打电话向家人或朋友求助。

choices.text: Use a map to identify your location.
choices.zh: 使用地图确定你的位置。

choices.text: Try to follow your footprints back.
choices.zh: 试着沿着你的脚印返回。

items.stem: What will happen if you follow an unknown stream in the woods?

choices.text: You may end up entering a wonderland.
choices.zh: 你可能最终进入一个仙境。

choices.text: You may get drowned in a sudden flood.
choices.zh: 你可能在突发的洪水中溺水。

choices.text: You may expose yourself to unexpected dangers.
choices.zh: 你可能会使自己暴露在意想不到的危险中。

choices.text: You may find a way out without your knowing it.
choices.zh: 你可能会在不知不觉中找到出路。

items.stem: What do many experts think is the wisest thing to do if you're lost in the woods?

choices.text: Wait patiently.
choices.zh: 耐心等待。

choices.text: Look for food.
choices.zh: 寻找食物。

choices.text: Start a fire.
choices.zh: 生火。

choices.text: Walk uphill.
choices.zh: 往山上走。

items.stem: What should you do before you go into the woods?

choices.text: Check the local weather.
choices.zh: 查看当地天气。

choices.text: Find a map and a compass.
choices.zh: 找一张地图和一个指南针。

choices.text: Prepare enough food and drink.
choices.zh: 准备足够的食物和饮料。

choices.text: Inform somebody of your plan.
choices.zh: 把你的计划告诉某人。
